title: Step 1a - SVR Model Training: Feature Scaling and Dataset Preparation in Python

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new practical activity on this time Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到這次新的實作，這次要做的是支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: So, have to start by telling you that the model we're about to implement will be slightly more advanced than the models we built before.
cues.zh: 首先要告訴你，接下來實作的模型，會比先前建立的模型稍微進階一些。

cues.en: But it's totally fine, we will do it together, and we will succeed a hundred percent.
cues.zh: 不過完全沒問題，我們會一起做，而且一定能成功。

cues.en: So, why is it slightly more advanced?
cues.zh: 為什麼稍微進階一點？

cues.en: Well, that's because we will have to play a lot with feature scaling.
cues.zh: 因為我們會大量運用特徵縮放。

cues.en: And I can tell you that after this implementation of the SVR model, you will be a master in feature scaling because you will know not only how to apply the feature scaling transformation,
cues.zh: 可以告訴你，實作完這個 SVR 模型後，你會非常熟悉特徵縮放，因為你不只會做特徵縮放轉換，

cues.en: but also how to apply the inverse transformation, you know, to go back to the original scaling.
cues.zh: 也會做反向轉換，也就是回到原本的尺度。

cues.en: So, you will know all the sub tools, let's say, of feature scaling, and you will handle them like a pro.
cues.zh: 所以你會掌握特徵縮放的各種小工具，並能熟練運用。

cues.en: Alright?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So, if you're ready, let's start.
cues.zh: 如果準備好了，就開始吧。

cues.en: And just before we go inside the folder, let's make sure here that we're all on the same page.
cues.zh: 進入資料夾之前，先確認大家都在同一個地方。

cues.en: I gave you the link to this folder, you know, containing all the codes and data sets right before this tutorial in an article.
cues.zh: 這堂課前面的文章裡，我提供了包含所有程式碼與資料集的資料夾連結。

cues.en: So, make sure to connect to it.
cues.zh: 所以請先開啟它。

cues.en: And now, we should all be on the same page, and, therefore, we're gonna go of course to "Part 2 - Regression" and then of course to Support Vector Regression, SVR.
cues.zh: 現在大家應該都在同一個地方，接著當然進入 Part 2 - Regression，再進入 Support Vector Regression，也就是 SVR。

cues.en: Alright, and as usual, we're gonna start with Python.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先從 Python 開始。

cues.en: So, we're gonna go to that Python folder, inside which you'll find the same dataset as before because, you know, I would like to compare the performance of different regression models on this dataset
cues.zh: 進入 Python 資料夾，裡面有和先前相同的資料集，因為我想比較不同迴歸模型，在這份資料集上的表現。

cues.en: which prove to have some non-linear relationships, you know, between the feature which is the level, you know, the position level going from 1 to 10 and the salary going from 45 thousand
cues.zh: 這份資料已經顯示，特徵與薪資之間有非線性關係；特徵是 1 到 10 的職位等級，而薪資從 4 萬 5 千

cues.en: to $1 million per year.
cues.zh: 到每年 100 萬美元。

cues.en: So, here again, this is exactly the same scenario.
cues.zh: 所以這裡同樣是完全相同的情境。

cues.en: We want to train this time a Support Vector Regression model to learn and understand the correlations between these position levels and these salaries.
cues.zh: 這次要訓練支援向量迴歸模型，讓它學習並理解這些職位等級與薪資之間的關係。

cues.en: And to quickly remind the context, we are hiring a new person who is expecting a $160k salary, justifying this by the fact that this person earned
cues.zh: 快速回顧背景：我們要錄用一個人，他希望薪資是 16 萬美元，理由是他在

cues.en: a $160k salary in the previous company.
cues.zh: 前一家公司就領 16 萬美元。

cues.en: This data is exactly the data of the previous company, you know, with the different position levels from business analyst to CEO and their corresponding salary.
cues.zh: 這些正是前一家公司的資料，包含從商業分析師到執行長的不同職位等級，以及各自對應的薪資。

cues.en: And so not only we want to train a model to learn these relationships, but also we want to deploy this model to predict the salary that this person had
cues.zh: 所以不只要訓練模型學習這些關係，也想實際使用模型，預測這個人在

cues.en: in this previous company, knowing that indeed this person was a region manager for a couple years and, therefore, is considered to have a position level of 6.5.
cues.zh: 前一家公司領的薪資。已知他擔任區域經理兩年，因此被視為職位等級 6.5。

cues.en: So, that's the exact same scenario, exact same data set.
cues.zh: 所以情境完全相同，資料集也完全相同。

cues.en: And so now, let's build the Support Vector Regression model on this data set to see if it performs better than the previous model,
cues.zh: 現在來對這份資料建立支援向量迴歸模型，看看表現是否比先前那個

cues.en: which showed great results the Polynomial Regression model.
cues.zh: 成果很好的多項式迴歸模型更好。

cues.en: Alright, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's close this, and let's open our Support Vector Regression implementation either with Google Colaboratory if you love it
cues.zh: 關閉這裡，打開支援向量迴歸的實作檔。喜歡的話，可以使用 Google Colaboratory，

cues.en: or with Jupyter Notebook because indeed it is an IPYNB file.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 Jupyter Notebook，因為這是 IPYNB 檔案。

cues.en: Alright, so that's the whole implementation.
cues.zh: 好，這就是整份實作。

cues.en: Let me quickly show you the structure of the implementation.
cues.zh: 快速展示一下實作的結構。

cues.en: We're gonna start by importing the libraries as usual then importing the data set, then applying feature scaling.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先匯入程式庫，再匯入資料集，接著套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: So, this is interesting.
cues.zh: 這裡很值得注意。

cues.en: This time we have to apply feature scaling because in the SVR model there is not this, you know, explicit equation of the dependent variable with respect to the features.
cues.zh: 這次必須套用特徵縮放，因為 SVR 模型沒有那種以特徵明確表示依變數的顯式方程式。

cues.en: And mostly there are not those, you know, coefficients multiplying each of the features and, therefore, not compensating with lower values for the features taking high values.
cues.zh: 主要是沒有每個特徵前面相乘的那些係數，因此不會用較小係數，來補償數值較大的特徵。

cues.en: Now, this time the Support Vector Regression model has an implicit equation of, you know, the dependent variable with respect to the features.
cues.zh: 這次支援向量迴歸模型中，依變數與特徵之間的關係是隱式方程式。

cues.en: So, we don't have such coefficients, and we will definitely have to apply feature scaling for this model.
cues.zh: 所以沒有這類係數，這個模型一定要套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: So, you see, you start to understand when and when not to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 你看，現在開始理解什麼時候需要、什麼時候不需要特徵縮放了。

cues.en: Well, you know, we don't have to apply feature scaling for linear regression models where you have indeed those coefficients that can compensate with the high values of the features.
cues.zh: 線性迴歸模型不一定需要特徵縮放，因為有那些係數，可以對特徵較大的數值進行補償。

cues.en: And so, of course these include Simple Linear Regression, Multiple Linear Regression, and Polynomial Regression.
cues.zh: 當然包括簡單線性迴歸、多元線性迴歸，以及多項式迴歸。

cues.en: And you will see later on in the course many other models.
cues.zh: 課程後面還會看到許多其他模型。

cues.en: And for other models which usually have an implicit equation, you know, an implicit relationship between the dependent variable Y and the features X,
cues.zh: 對於其他通常使用隱式方程式，也就是依變數 y 與特徵 X 之間是隱式關係的模型，

cues.en: well, usually for these models we have to apply feature scaling.
cues.zh: 講者表示，通常需要套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: Alright?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: Then we will of course train the SVR model on the whole data set.
cues.zh: 接著當然會在整份資料集上，訓練 SVR 模型。

cues.en: You know, this time is the same.
cues.zh: 這次也是一樣。

cues.en: We won't split the whole data set into a training set and a test set because we want to leverage the maximum data to learn these correlations between those position levels and the salaries.
cues.zh: 不將整份資料集分為訓練集與測試集，因為希望利用最多資料，學習職位等級與薪資之間的關係。

cues.en: So, we won't do that split and we will directly train the SVR model on the whole data set.
cues.zh: 所以不做切分，直接在整份資料集上訓練 SVR 模型。

cues.en: Then after this training, well we'll have a smart SVR model which, therefore, we're gonna use to predict this new result and exactly that salary of this position level of 6.5.
cues.zh: 訓練後，就會有一個學到規律的 SVR 模型，再用它預測新結果，也就是職位等級 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: And we will compare of course that prediction with the prediction of the Polynomial Regression model, which I've kept here.
cues.zh: 當然會把這個預測，和我保留在這裡的多項式迴歸預測比較。

cues.en: And then of course we will visualize the SVR results in low resolution and high resolution to see of course the regression curve of the SVR model.
cues.zh: 接著以低解析度與高解析度，將 SVR 結果視覺化，看看 SVR 模型的迴歸曲線。

cues.en: Alright, I'm sure you noticed that I did not click on each of these contents.
cues.zh: 你一定注意到了，我沒有展開這些內容。

cues.en: Well, I did that on purpose.
cues.zh: 這是刻意的。

cues.en: It's because I don't wanna reveal the prediction, you know, the predicted salary by the SVR model.
cues.zh: 因為不想提前揭露 SVR 模型預測的薪資。

cues.en: I want us to save the surprise until, you know, we execute that sale to return that predicted salary.
cues.zh: 我想把驚喜留到執行那個儲存格，回傳預測薪資的時候。
